metadata.title: Traditional Chinese 120 Radical/Component Learning Set
metadata.purpose: Character Playground database for a 3-phase beginner to TOCFL B1 Mandarin course.
metadata.note: This is a practical radical/component learning set, not a strict Kangxi radical dictionary. Some items are full characters that are useful as components or semantic/phonetic families.

phaseSummary.name: A1 Phase
phaseSummary.goal: Daily-life components for A1 to A2 reading

phaseSummary.name: A2 Phase
phaseSummary.goal: Expansion components for TOCFL B1 bridge, workplace, and formal vocabulary

radicals.learningRole: Human/person meaning; appears in characters about people, human actions, or human scale.
radicals.meaningChangeRule: When combined with another component, this part usually gives a semantic clue, a sound clue, or both. The meaning often shifts from literal object/action to an abstract family of meanings. Do not force a perfect literal story; use it as a recognition and memory aid.
